17:30 Local Time, 16:30 GMT, 22:00 IST: Sri Lanka were hammered by the hosts in the first game. England led by Brook's blitzkrieg notched up more than 250 and defended it with aplomb. Sri Lanka never were really in the game. Buttler took it away initially and Brook batted them out of the game. Cardiff should again favour the batters as there will be nice bounce on offer.
